description: Defines data structures, constants, and enums for Android's RPC wire protocol, including address, connection headers, transaction, reply, and command definitions.

classes.name: RpcWireAddress
classes.description: Represents a network address with options and address fields, with methods to convert to and from raw 64-bit data.

classes.name: RpcConnectionHeader
classes.description: Contains connection request details such as version, options, transport mode, and session ID size.

classes.name: RpcNewSessionResponse
classes.description: Provides response information for a new session request, including supported version.

classes.name: RpcOutgoingConnectionInit
classes.description: Initial message sent when setting up a client connection, includes a message and reserved space.

classes.name: RpcWireHeader
classes.description: Header for wire protocol messages, indicating command type and body size.

classes.name: RpcDecStrong
classes.description: Represents a strong reference with an address and amount.

classes.name: RpcWireTransaction
classes.description: Structure for transmitting a transaction, including address, code, flags, async number, and data size.

classes.name: RpcWireReply
classes.description: Structure for reply messages, including status and parcel data size, with version-dependent size calculation.

methods.name: fromRaw
methods.description: Converts a 64-bit raw value into an RpcWireAddress.

methods.name: toRaw
methods.description: Converts an RpcWireAddress into a 64-bit raw value.

methods.name: wireSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of RpcWireReply based on protocol version.
